newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices steady, rally seen next week.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices steady, rally seen next week.

text.p: Sugar prices held steady at the reduced level in a narrow price band on Thursday, dealers said.

"Consumer demand was low but on expectation of a rise in demand in the coming days, fresh offerings were limited," a dealer said. Sugar arrivals from mills was affected by heavy rains, one trader said.
Ready delivery sugar S-30 was quiet at 1,250/1,275 rupees per quintal while M-30 was steady at 1,272/1,330 rupees per quintal. Sugar mill delivery was steady at 1,160/1,180 rupees per quintal.
Traders were expecting a small rally next week.
